findings.evidence: `MixedIIDWith.blockLaw_eq_mixture` in `MixedIID/Basic.lean:134` gives the same right-hand side for any two injective `Fin m → ι`; `ExchangeableFamily.comp_injective` and its API exist in `Exchangeability/Family.lean:100`, but `rg "MixedIIDWith.exchangeableFamily|MixedIID.exchangeableFamily"` has no hit.
findings.fix: Add `MixedIIDWith.exchangeableFamily` and `MixedIID.exchangeableFamily` for arbitrary `ι`, and optionally derive the existing sequence lemmas from `ExchangeableFamily.exchangeable`.
findings.issue: `MixedIIDWith.exchangeableAt`/`.exchangeable` and the existential counterpart remain sequence-only, while arbitrary-index `MixedIIDWith` directly implies `ExchangeableFamily`; generic consumers therefore cannot obtain the symmetry class characterized by the same block laws.

summary: The generalized predicate is missing its natural bridge to the existing arbitrary-index exchangeability API.
